risk: Driver and radiator flange thicknesses are not dimensioned
consequence: The clamp hard stop can under-compress or over-compress a gasket.
mitigation: Measure both purchased components, enter the values in config/physical_calibration.yaml, and pass both component coupons.

risk: Core board placement is absent from the official assembled CAD
consequence: A source-only claim of exact Core placement would be unsupported.
mitigation: The CAD reserves a Core-sized service volume. Confirm the official Core/HAT stack against the physical Batch 1 kit before closing the upper stack.

consequence: Full amplifier voltage below tuning can exceed driver or radiator travel.
mitigation: Start with the documented fourth-order high-pass, verify polarity and tuning with an impedance sweep, then set DSP from measurements.

risk: Printed walls and compressed seals have not been leak tested
consequence: A leak can remove the expected passive-radiator bass response.
mitigation: Use the temporary leak-test adapter at 100-250 Pa, inspect every joint, and then confirm the final cable gland by impedance measurement.

consequence: Nominal CAD clearances may become interference or loose fits.
mitigation: Complete all eight calibration checks and regenerate with make calibrated-release before any full-size print.

risk: Wake-word, Wi-Fi, LED, and button performance are unmeasured
consequence: The final enclosure can affect radio and acoustic behavior even when openings clear.
mitigation: Run the controlled bare-kit versus enclosed-kit commissioning tests.

consequence: The Core or amplifier may throttle or exceed a safe temperature margin.
mitigation: Perform the documented 25 C and 35 C thermal soaks with instrumented hardware.

risk: Insert pullout strength depends on printer, material, and installation
consequence: An insert can rotate or pull free during service.
mitigation: Select the coupon bore that installs square, torque-test it cold, and reserve the 250 N pull test for formal physical validation.

risk: Satellite1.1 / Batch 2 is not supported by this release
consequence: Its external Wi-Fi antenna and service interfaces are not accommodated.
mitigation: Use only Batch 1 rev4.1 Core + rev4.1 HAT. Add a validated adapter before claiming Batch 2 compatibility.
